timestamp_semantics: monotonic logical append time after the Campaign193 terminal authority
purpose: Freeze a finite securities-firm investment-banking mandate, client-project pipeline, underwriting-syndicate and distribution lifecycle before source rows, project values, formulas, directions, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Existing Campaign145-193 source-frontier and source-scouting JSON records plus the immutable Campaign127 convertible-issue contract only
repository_evidence.campaign127_boundary: Campaign127 measures an issuer's completed convertible issue online excess-subscription demand. It does not identify the listed securities intermediary's mandate portfolio, sponsor role, client-project stage pipeline, syndicate allocation, unsold commitment or distribution lifecycle.
repository_evidence.campaign168_boundary: Campaign168 freezes generic customer, footprint, utilization and realized-volume KPIs. A legally identified investment-banking mandate or regulator-tracked client project is a role- and stage-dependent intermediary state, not a generic customer count or operating volume.
repository_evidence.campaign169_boundary: Campaign169 freezes commercial prices, fees and selling terms. Advisory fees, underwriting spreads and take rates are therefore pricing states; Campaign194 is limited to mandate, project-stage, role, commitment, allocation and distribution lifecycle identity.
repository_evidence.campaign177_boundary: Campaign177 observes the issuer, acquirer or target transaction lifecycle, consideration and control transfer. Campaign194 may not relabel those issuer-side deal states; it requires the intermediary's own client mandate and complete portfolio role history across all projects.
repository_evidence.campaign181_boundary: Campaign181 freezes securities-firm net capital, risk coverage, liquidity and supervisory remediation. Own regulatory resources are not client mandates, regulator project stages, syndicate commitments or distribution outcomes.
repository_evidence.campaign182_boundary: Campaign182 observes the borrower or issuer's facility, lender consent and financing commitment, including refinancing underwriting. Campaign194 excludes borrower financing certainty and instead requires the securities intermediary's service role, project backlog and distribution exposure across its client portfolio.
repository_evidence.insurance_underwriting_boundary: Insurance underwriting, premium, claims and reserve states use a different legal risk-transfer meaning. The shared word underwriting does not make insurance policies a securities-offering mandate or syndicate-distribution state.
repository_evidence.sector_scope_boundary: Point-in-time licensed securities firm, investment bank, sponsor or financial-adviser scope and listed-parent mapping must be frozen. Non-intermediary issuers are structurally not applicable and may not be filled with zero or ranked cross-sector.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current sponsor-project register, latest annual-report backlog or surviving client roster cannot be projected backward without mandate execution, role, acceptance, inquiry, suspension, resumption, approval, registration, issuance, pricing, allocation, closing, withdrawal, termination, correction and first-public histories.

reference date, reporting period, mandate execution, filing acceptance, inquiry, response, suspension, resumption, review, registration, approval, pricing, allocation, issuance, closing, withdrawal, termination, first-public, correction and supersession timestamps with trading-session availability

listed security, listed parent, licensed securities subsidiary, branch, sponsor representative, financial adviser, lead or joint underwriter, bookrunner, coordinator, syndicate member, issuer, seller, target and controlling-parent mapping without current-state leakage

role taxonomy separating sponsor, independent financial adviser, lead or joint lead underwriter, bookrunner, coordinator, placement agent, trustee, arranger and syndicate participant, including role start, transfer, replacement and termination

project and instrument taxonomy separating IPO, secondary listing, follow-on, rights, convertible, exchangeable, corporate or enterprise bond, financial bond, asset-backed security, M&A, major-asset restructuring, tender, privatization and other advisory work

project amount, offered amount, committed amount, allocated amount, settled amount, retained exposure, expected versus contracted fee and recognized revenue or cash semantics with currency, unit, gross or net presentation and no cross-project double counting

point-in-time client, project, instrument, intermediary and syndicate identifier histories covering renaming, merger, spin-off, parent change, intermediary replacement, multiple concurrent roles, corrections and delisted listed parents

missing, confidential, pending, suspended, withdrawn, failed, expired, not-applicable, true zero project count, zero unsold amount, undisclosed fee and structural non-intermediary semantics without favorable absence coding

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full eligible licensed-intermediary denominator, delisting and corporate-action coverage, document pagination and parser, identity, chronology, role, stage, amount, allocation, no-double-count and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Three distinct securities-intermediary mandate, client-project pipeline and underwriting-distribution states remain deferred at source admission; issuer-side financing or transaction relabeling, regulatory-capital and insurance-underwriting relabeling, Campaign169 pricing overlap, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
